text:
kai: Quick shout Game & Gear Swap next Wed evening? Steam keys, spare controllers, and a tiny tournament for Guilty Gear Strive on the side.
mo: Ooh I can bring a couple of wired Xbox pads and my old steam key bundle (leftovers). Free to grab. :package:
rachel: I'm in if there's room for co-op couch classics. Can we set a 'no spoilers' rule for single-player story games?
diego: Will bring my Switch + handhelds. Also got one extra dock and a wireless adapter.
sara: I can host a 4-player Smash bracket and run the bracket sheet. Anyone cool to stream finals to the mezz projector?
events-bot: Poll created: Stream finals to mezz projector? React :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
mo: :thumbsup:
kai: projector yes. Also proposing a sticker/steam-key pinboard take one, leave one.
rachel: can we have a tiny "best low-risk snack" contest? winner gets the last slice. :pizza:
diego: I'll bring surge strips and an extra ethernet cable. Also tagging @here for RSVPs so I can reserve table space.
sara: I can do stream for finals if someone helps with OBS scene switching. quick handover after semis.
kai: Awesome. Plan: setup 6:30, start 7. RSVP by Tue noon. Bring labeled power bricks. See you! :sparkles:
